name: Anjani Foods Ltd
about: Incorporated on 1983, Anjani Foods Ltd does Production and Sale of Bakery Products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AFL is a part of Anjani Vishnu group. It is a bakery retailer & distributor, with outlets spread across 5 
districts from Srikakulam to Godavari. It manufactures  different varieties of cookies, cakes and breads

cons: Stock is trading at 4.09 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.05% over last 3 years.
